newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Beirut only climber in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Beirut only climber in Beirut.

text.p: Bank of Beirut was the only climber on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday but brokers expected the market to pick up.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.79 percent to 195.01 and the LISPI climbed 0.13 percent to 97.71 while the BLOM fell 0.29 percent to 1112.06.
BSE turnover fell 69 percent to 173,813 from 293,437 for a value of $2,089,456 against $3,902,259.
BOB rose to $5.75 from $5.5. Banque Audi fell to $27.5 from $27.75 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce dropped to $21.25 from $21.5.
Solidere A was flat at $13 while B shares fell to $13 from $13.125.
"It was a steady market today but it will not stay like this. Solidere is expected to increase," said one broker who requested anonymity.
Ciments Libanais was steady at $1.2813 and Pipemaker Eternit was flat at $2.00.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Uniceramic and Ciments Blancs.
